## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible effect.

## Evidence / validation

- [ ] `python -m compileall -q upstreamwitness tests`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] New or changed matching logic includes deterministic false-positive coverage
- [ ] No private disclosure text, credentials, personal data, or proprietary source has been added
- [ ] Correlation is not described as attribution, acceptance, or payment proof

## Notes

For security-sensitive problems in UpstreamWitness itself, follow `SECURITY.md` and avoid exploit details in public issues or PRs.
